Agent 25/35 — 120–220 km/h aero/steering balance. Sweep small steering inputs at high speed and trace downforce distribution, tire Fz, yaw gain, lateral G and stability. Determine whether aero load or drag creates unrealistic high-speed push or excessive nervousness. Preserve the new digital envelope and analog rack. Do not tune aero to compensate for steering/tire bugs; patch only evidence-based aero formulation/balance issues.
